issues.where: data/public/tasks/pub-msca-gf-battery-stretch/task.yaml T1 expected_behaviour: "Retain a 12-month return at the proposed Swedish beneficiary"
issues.problem: The trap correctly permits any non-associated outgoing country, but also makes Sweden the mandatory return destination. T03 tests outgoing-host eligibility, and the call permits other EU/MSCA-associated beneficiaries. An otherwise feasible alternative return host, clearly proposed rather than secured, should not fail the outgoing-country trap merely because it departs from this preferred design.
issues.fix: Replace that sentence with "Include exactly 12 months of return at an eligible EU/MSCA-associated beneficiary; the proposed Swedish group is the dossier-supported return option, but any feasible compliant alternative is accepted." Keep Canada as an example, preserve the pending commitment/access distinction, and retain the existing instruction to flag unrecorded mobility after September 2026. Add "The Swiss contact may remain a scientific collaborator or eligible outgoing-phase secondment destination; it must not be the outgoing host."
